response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM award_counts) SELECT ac.player_id, ac.count, ac.count * 1.0 / tc.total as fraction FROM award_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
